title: Praxis with Euclidean coefficient norm and range-dependent covolume
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5548 MiB (5.4174 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 20670 million field multiplications (14437 and 6233), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, P1, C5, n, D, ell, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound, I2, msis_norm, I5, mu_tr) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
